title: Elapsed time in a simplified approval redesign
method: Synthetic assumptions: each review waits 6 hours and takes 0.25 hours. Four sequential=25 hours. Two independent parallel reviews starting together=6.25 elapsed hours and 0.5reviewer-hours. Validity depends on equivalent controls and independence.
alt: A hypothetical approval path changes from 25 elapsed hours sequentially to 6.25 hours with two independent parallel reviews.
